ios.desc:
PageEcho — Read Together with AI

A fully on-device eBook reader with offline AI and natural text-to-speech.
No server. No accounts. No tracking.
Your books and reading stay 100% private on your device.

1. Read Smarter — Fully On-Device

PageEcho uses Apple Intelligence and local AI models to help you understand and explore books — without sending any content to external servers.
Everything runs locally for speed, privacy, and peace of mind.
	•	AI-powered chapter insights
	•	Instant on-device summaries
	•	Interactive book Q&A
	•	Fast, private, and fully offline

All processing is performed locally for maximum privacy and speed.

2. A Minimalist EBook Reader Designed for Focus

A clean, distraction-free reading experience built for long sessions.
Smooth chapter navigation, calm typography, and flexible layouts help you stay immersed.

	•	EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, and PDF support
	•	Chapter-based reading and TOC navigation
	•	Custom themes, fonts, and spacing

3. Natural On-Device Text-to-Speech

Listen to your books with high-quality, real-time speech synthesis — fully offline.

	•	Powered by Supertonic, Kokoro and Apple system voices
	•	Zero latency, no network required
	•	Accurately reads numbers, dates, and complex text
	•	Ideal for studying, commuting, or hands-free reading

4. AI Summaries and Smart Book Chat + AI Mind-Map

Generate chapter summaries, clarify concepts, and explore deeper insights with fully offline AI.
	•	Chapter summarization
	•	Book discussion and Q&A
	•	Topic and theme extraction
	•	All processed locally on your device
Your reading data is never uploaded or shared.

5. 100% Private by Design

PageEcho is built around absolute privacy.

	•	No servers
	•	No accounts
	•	No tracking or analytics
	•	All AI features run locally on your device

Your books, reading history, and activity never leave your device.

Whether you’re studying literature, exploring classics, or simply reading for enjoyment, PageEcho provides a focused and intelligent reading environment without compromising privacy.

6. PageEcho Premium

Unlock the full experience with unlimited access to advanced features.

	•	Unlimited on-device text-to-speech
	•	Unlimited AI summaries, chat, and mind maps
	•	Monthly, yearly, or lifetime access options

show_hn.title: Show HN: PageEcho – Offline AI eBook Reader (On-Device TTS and AI)

quotes.text:
Hi HN!
I built PageEcho, a fully on-device eBook reader for iOS that integrates offline TTS and Apple Intelligence features. It started as a personal challenge to create a reading app that never sends data to a server while still supporting modern AI capabilities.

What’s unique:
• Everything — TTS, summaries, Q&A, mind-maps, translation — runs locally on the device
• Supports EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, TXT, and FB2 with a single unified reading pipeline
• Uses Supertonic ONNX for high-quality offline speech (no cloud, no latency)
• Integrates Apple Intelligence for chapter-level analysis on supported devices
• Local SQLite storage for highlights, progress, and reading analytics

Technical notes for those curious:
• EPUB/TXT/MOBI parsing is consolidated into a WebView-based renderer with CFI support
• PDF mode uses native PDFKit overlays with TTS + translation layers
• TTS runs on-device using a quantized Supertonic model with chunked streaming
• AI summaries/Q&A rely on local Apple Intelligence calls with caching at the chapter level
• The entire app operates offline — no accounts, no telemetry, no external servers

I’d love feedback from readers, mobile devs, and anyone interested in on-device AI design.  
Happy to answer any technical questions!
